Jack Herer To Emcee 99 Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo

December 15, 1998

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

JACK HERER TO EMCEE 99 SANTA CRUZ INDUSTRIAL HEMP EXPO

CATALYST HOSTS SATURDAY NIGHT PARTY

Long time hemp advocate Jack Herer, author of the hemp classic "The Emperor Wears No Clothes," will be emcee for the Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo, slated for Saturday and Sunday, March 20 and 21 at the Civic Auditorium in Santa Cruz, California.

Santa Cruz premier nightclub, The Catalyst, will be hosting the Expo’s Saturday Night Party. 300 "insider" tickets will be provided for Expo vendors, sponsors and the media. An additional 500 tickets will be sold at the door. Special musical guests for the evening will be announced when confirmed.

Local graphic designer Toni McVay, whose highly acclaimed display ads and brochure work added significantly to the overall success of last year’s Expo promotion effort, will be concepting and producing promotional pieces for the ‘99 show. Other tentative developments will be announced when confirmed.

Over 50 booths, a hemp fashion show, a hemp house, hemp foods, educational and historical exhibits, speakers, lectures and panel discussions will be featured. Attendance of 6000 for the two-day event is expected. Admission is $5 per day.

For more information call the Hemp Expo’s publicity voicemail at (831) 425-3003, or visit on the web at www.cruzexpo.com or contact Bob Lamonica, Producer phone/fax: (831) 457-2670 e-mail: bob@cruzexpo.com

The Hemp Page of Marijuananews.com is edited by John E. Dvorak, Hempologist& Managing Editor, Hemp Magazine.

John was born in Fort Worth, Texas, but is an eight year resident of Allston/Brighton, MA, where he is the proprietor of the Boston Hemp Co-op and Managing Editor of Hemp Magazine. He is a member of the Hemp Industries Association, the International Hemp Association, and Mass/Cann NORML.
